id: title:jurajmajerik:clear the new experiment form when abandoned

review.posthog_relevance: Removes sessionStorage-based draft persistence and team-scoped storage keys for the Experiment creation form, potentially preventing recovery of incomplete experiments and removing stale state, while also removing the re-validation of feature flag keys on remount.
review.reason: The observed changes remove sessionStorage-based draft persistence, associated TTL, storage keys, and helper functions, along with the cancelForm action and its listeners. This could prevent accidental recovery of incomplete experiments or stale drafts and remove a potential source of unexpected behavior or stale state. It also removes the re-validation of feature flag keys on rem.
review.uncertainty: The actual benefit of removing draft persistence is not demonstrated; it could either improve reliability by removing stale state or negatively impact users who rely on recovering incomplete experiments. The score is assigned based on the removal of a bounded capability rather than a demonstrated systemic improvement.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, conservative grouping of changes. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Removes sessionStorage-based draft persistence and its associated TTL, storage key, and helper functions. Removes the formCanceled state and cancelForm action. Removes the beforeUnmount listener that wrote drafts and the cancelForm listener that cleared drafts. Removes the post-save clearDraftStorage call. Removes the afterMount re-validation of feature flag key.
observations.posthog_connection: Removes the ability for the Experiment creation form to retain user input across page navigation or tab switching, and removes the re-validation of feature flag keys on remount. This could prevent accidental recovery of incomplete experiments or stale drafts, and could remove a potential source of unexpected behavior or stale state. It also removes the re-validation of feature flag

observations.behavior: Removes the DRAFT_STORAGE_KEY and its team-scoped construction, and the DRAFT_TTL_MS constant.
observations.posthog_connection: Removes the team-scoped draft storage key, removing the ability to distinguish drafts between teams. This could prevent cross-team contamination of drafts, but also removes the recovery mechanism.

observations.behavior: Removes the cancelForm action and its associated state and listener, and the beforeUnmount and cancelForm listeners that wrote or cleared drafts.
